camera.title: Camera

contribution.title: Contribution
contribution.provisionalNote: Points count once someone confirms it.

contribution.coolingNone: This action doesn’t add modeled cooling, but it keeps the plan going.

contribution.survivalNote: Each check earns points. Miss one and the points pause; they don’t vanish.
contribution.confirmSub: In v0 this confirms on this device.

contribution.notFound: This action isn’t on this device.
